question: Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy received the Padma Vibhushan in 2025 for his contributions in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medicine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy** was conferred with the **Padma Vibhushan** in the year **2025** for his exceptional and distinguished service in the field of **Medicine**.
 
• He is a world-renowned **gastroenterologist** and serves as the **Chairman and Founder** of the **Asian Institute of Gastroenterology (AIG)** located in **Hyderabad**, **Telangana**.
 
• His pioneering work is primarily in the field of **Therapeutic Endoscopy**, where he has introduced innovative techniques that have revolutionized gastrointestinal treatments globally.
 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the **second-highest civilian award** in **India**, preceded by the Bharat Ratna and followed by the Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.
 
• Dr. Reddy is recognized as one of the world's leading experts in **Gastrointestinal Endoscopy** and has trained thousands of doctors from across the globe at his institute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Previous Honors:** Prior to receiving the **Padma Vibhushan** in **2025**, Dr. Nageshwar Reddy was awarded the **Padma Shri** in **2002** and the **Padma Bhushan** in **2016**. This makes him one of the few medical professionals to receive three of the top four civilian honors.
 
• **International Recognition:** In **2021**, he became the first **Indian** doctor to receive the **Rudolf V. Schindler Award**, which is the highest honor bestowed by the **American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy (ASGE)**.
 
• **Academic Contributions:** He has published over **600 papers** in international journals and has served as the **President** of the **World Endoscopy Organization**.
 
• **Medical Service:** Under his leadership, **AIG Hospitals** in **Hyderabad** has emerged as one of the largest referral centers in the world for complex gastrointestinal procedures, combining **affordable healthcare** with cutting-edge **medical technology**.
 
• **Awards in other fields:** While options like **Art**, **Public Affairs**, and **Trade and Industry** are categories for **Padma Awards**, Dr. Reddy’s lifelong dedication has been exclusively toward **clinical research** and **patient care** in the medical sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Padma Awards Process:** The **Padma Awards** are announced every year on the occasion of **Republic Day** (**January 26th**) and are presented by the **President of India** at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• **Eligibility:** These awards are given in various disciplines such as **Art**, **Social Work**, **Public Affairs**, **Science and Engineering**, **Trade and Industry**, **Medicine**, **Literature and Education**, **Sports**, and **Civil Service**.
 
• **Selection Committee:** The **Padma Awards Committee** is constituted by the **Prime Minister of India** every year, and the recommendations are submitted to the **Prime Minister** and the **President** for approval.
 
• **Significance of the 2025 List:** The **2025** list highlights individuals who have made "exceptional and distinguished" contributions, and **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy** represents the highest standard of **medical excellence** and **scientific temperament** in **India**.
